task.title: Phase L milestone L1 (awkit-djnl.1): AI foundation, autonomy policy and performance go/no-go
task.objective: Start L1 per docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/L1-ai-foundation.md. This contract covers only the Risk-3 paths L1 must touch: the autonomy policy (src/security/authz/AiAutonomyPolicy.ts, classified authorization_change so T3 and ceiling edits stay lease-gated) and the explicit AI permissions in src/security/authz/Permissions.ts (security lease), the source-controlled model manifest src/offline/AiModelManifest.ts (release lease), and the Beads and routing-matrix bookkeeping (project-state lease). Ordinary L1 code under src/ai, app/main, app/renderer, scripts and docs is unleased direct-loop work, disclosed rather than hidden.

acceptance.description: AiAutonomyPolicy decides observe/suggest/autoApply/forbidden per the ratified table: ceilings equal defaults, configuration only lowers, the T2 cap and the exact T3 list are code constants, T3 is unreachable under every configuration, and self-demotion trips only above the threshold with a minimum sample.
The typecheck and bundles pass with the policy in place.

evidence.observed: 62/62 on the final state: exhaustive 968-case tier matrix against an independently restated table, 3,916 T3 probes all forbidden with T3 reasons under every configuration including the switch off, ceilings and the T2 cap, self-demotion thresholds, and the settings store refusing any tier above a ceiling. Four mutations (raised ceiling, keyword-sensitive step, protected-login interpretation, demotion at the threshold) were each caught.
tsc --noEmit and electron-vite build passed on the final state (016c37c plus docs); typecheck:scripts also passed.

completion.qa_basis: The leased Risk-3 deliverables (autonomy policy, AI permissions, model manifest, routing and bead bookkeeping) are committed and verified: verify:ai-autonomy-policy 62/62, verify:ai-permissions 66/66, verify:ai-model-pack 46/46, verify:authz 92/92, verify:agent-routing 1112/1112, verify:roadmap-dashboard with Sources agree, build PASS, each new verifier mutation-tested except the GUI suite.
completion.qa_known_limitations: L1 itself stays open (awkit-djnl.1 in_progress). The real inference host, the llama.cpp runtime pin, the first manifest entry, the model and runtime notices, verify:ai-model-live and the L1.8 benchmark and go/no-go are BLOCKED. They need an owner decision on the runtime binding and an approved runtime and model pack. The manifest is deliberately empty and AI_RUNTIME_PIN.build is null. Unleased direct-loop edits outside this contract's routing (src/ai, app/main, app/renderer, scripts, docs) are disclosed here and in TASK_LOG, not hidden, so the derived scope escapes are expected. No independent QC review was run: subagents were not requested.
